name: terminfiks
description: TerminFiks: booking link + WhatsApp reminders for barbershops. Front end (Vite) and back end (.NET 10) in one repo.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && dotnet tool restore && dotnet restore
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && dotnet build backend
scripts.migration:add: cd backend && dotnet tool run dotnet-ef migrations add --project TerminFiks.Api
